content: Fastify v5.10.0 is current latest (v4.x maintained, v3.x EOL). Official plugin ecosystem versions verified via npm registry: @fastify/cors 11.3.0, @fastify/helmet 13.1.0, @fastify/rate-limit 11.1.0, @fastify/cookie 11.1.1, @fastify/static 9.3.0. No fastify-session needed since better-auth manages its own cookie-based sessions.
